audit.reasoning: The coding (fixed-dominant penult, '10 010 0010') rests on the primary fieldworker's 2021 Dictionaria introduction; I fetched sources both the live page and the author's PDF and confirmed the quotation verbatim in section 6.2 (PDF p. 11), with IPA examples showing penult primary stress and leftward alternating secondaries exactly as coded. The record's cite/loc/grade fields are empty even though the source text is in 'sources'; fill them (François 2021, Dictionaria 15, Introduction section 6.2 Phonology, p. 11; Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.5653063) and point 'held' at François 2009 (fetched sources) is silent on stress; no better description exists (author states a full grammar is only in preparation); Tryon 2002's 14-pp sketch is the only unheld item and is print-only, low priority. No recode needed.
